description: Enterprise Products Partners processes, transports, stores, and ships oil and natural gas products across the United States. Enterprise is a "midstream” energy company, meaning it connects the producers of oil and gas with distributors and retailers. The company oversees about 50,000 miles of pipelines, most originating in Louisiana and Texas. It also owns shipping docks and storage facilities for the export of oil and gas products, and natural gas processing facilities. Founded in 1965, Enterprise Products is based in Houston.

title: Enterprise Products Partners

rankings.title: Fortune 500
rankings.itemDescription:
The oil and gas pipeline and transportation production company jumped 17 places on this year’s list as Russia’s 2022 invasion of Ukraine created an energy shortage that boosted demand in the sector.

  • The company was the most profitable pipeline firm on this year’s Fortune 500, bringing in $5.5 billion in profits in 2022, up 18% from the year prior.

  • The company’s $58 billion in revenue represented a staggering 43% increase from 2021, as oil prices rose significantly in 2022.

  • In February 2022, one of the company’s affiliates acquired Navitas Midstream for $3.25 billion, marking an expansion into natural gas processing.

rankings.title: Fortune 500
rankings.itemDescription: Houston-based Enterprise Products provides midstream energy services—think processing, transportation, and storage—of natural gas, natural gas liquids, crude oil, and refined petroleum products. In 2021, the company posted 50% year-over-year revenue growth, jumping 16 spots on the Fortune 500 list. In April 2022 Enterprise Products Operating, a subsidiary of the company, announced that it would work toward a carbon dioxide and sequestration solution for the Texas Gulf Coast, a potential tool for fighting CO2 emissions and climate change.
